## Description {#details}



<p>Configuration for a logical video sender whose StreamId is generated by the library. Exactly one extension is required for a GPU API:</p>


<ul class="doxyList ">
<li>QAR_GRAPHICS_API_D3D11 requires <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qarstreamparamsd3d11">QarStreamParamsD3D11</a>.</li>
<li>QAR_GRAPHICS_API_OPENGL requires exactly one of QarStreamParamsOpenGlEgl, QarStreamParamsOpenGlWgl or QarStreamParamsOpenGlGlx, whichever matches the context you own.</li>
<li>QAR_GRAPHICS_API_VULKAN requires QarStreamParamsVulkan. QAR_GRAPHICS_API_CPU supports no extension and requires <span class="doxyComputerOutput">header.next</span> to be null. The selected extension's <span class="doxyComputerOutput">header.next</span> must also be null. Retrieve the generated id with <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/groups/qar-c-video-sender/#ga36d84c1cbe1e39cead8aa115a1b09350">qar_video_sender_stream_id()</a>.</li>
</ul>

<p>Definition at line 1996 of file <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/files/qar-streaming-c/include/qar-streaming-h">qar_streaming.h</a>.</p>
